verdict.rationale: Cloudflare runs a fleet of first-party managed remote MCP servers that are explicitly documented for natural-language operation of a Cloudflare account. These include Workers Bindings, Builds and Observability, plus a Code Mode server covering the full API of more than 2,500 endpoints. It also ships a Skills plugin with slash commands and an agent-setup hub covering many agents. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface (operation depends on an external MCP client such as Claude or Cursor), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: allowing you to connect to Cloudflare's service from an MCP client (e.g. Cursor, Claude) and use natural language to accomplish tasks through your Cloudflare account
provides access to the entire Cloudflare API — over 2,500 endpoints across DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust, and every other product — through just two tools: search() and execute()
You can install the Cloudflare Skills plugin, which bundles the Cloudflare MCP servers alongside contextual skills and slash commands for building on Cloudflare.
Just connect to the MCP server URL - you'll be redirected to Cloudflare to authorize and select permissions.
